title: cephalaria syriaca
intro: Cephalaria syriaca, commonly known as Syrian honeysuckle or goat's beard, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria syriaca are attributed to its ability to inhibit histamine release and exhibit antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
